mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate signals accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates on equity cash flows and driving positive 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (p > 0.05 in t-test) or FEDFUNDS does not remain below 4.5% for 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: An unexpected surge in CPIAUCSL above 305 signals inflationary pressure, prompting risk aversion and negative 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) when CPIAUCSL crosses above 305, or the threshold is not met.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low federal funds rates and strong economic demand (high GDPC1) indicates accommodative policy and robust growth, driving positive 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 60-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when both proxies meet the condition, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, strong supply growth (high INDPRO) and low unemployment (low UNRATE) reflect robust economic activity, leading to positive 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when both proxies align with late-cycle expansion indicators, or the regime is not active.

mechanism_narrative: Persistent high demand (HOUST above 1400 units) signals strong consumer confidence, driving positive 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 5-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when HOUST exceeds 1400, or the trend reverses.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in UNRATE above 3.7% signals labor market stress, prompting risk aversion and negative 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) when UNRATE crosses above 3.7%, or the trigger does not occur.

mechanism_narrative: A prolonged period of low federal funds rates coupled with strong economic demand (high GDPC1) creates a favorable environment for equity growth, resulting in positive 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 60-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when both proxies meet the condition, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, rising federal funds rates and contracting economic demand (low GDPC1) signal contractionary policy, leading to negative 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) when both proxies align with tightening conditions, or the regime is not active.
